#![feature(rustc_private)]
#![crate_type = "lib"]
extern crate libc;
extern crate fakelibc;

use core::ffi::c_int;

pub fn pid() -> libc::pid_t {
    // SAFETY: getpid has no preconditions.
    unsafe { libc::getpid() }
}
pub fn pgrp() -> libc::pid_t {
    // SAFETY: getpgrp has no preconditions.
    unsafe { libc::getpgrp() }
}
pub fn euid() -> libc::uid_t {
    // SAFETY: geteuid has no preconditions.
    unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
}
pub fn sid(p: libc::pid_t) -> libc::pid_t {
    // SAFETY: any pid is accepted.
    unsafe { libc::getsid(p) }
}
pub fn fg(fd: c_int) -> libc::pid_t {
    // SAFETY: any fd is accepted.
    unsafe { libc::tcgetpgrp(fd) }
}
pub fn raise_it(sig: c_int) -> c_int {
    // SAFETY: any signal number is accepted.
    unsafe { libc::raise(sig) }
}
pub fn errno_slot() -> *mut c_int {
    // SAFETY: always succeeds.
    unsafe { libc::__error() }
}
mod own {
    unsafe extern "C" {
        pub fn getpid() -> i32;
    }
}
pub fn own_pid() -> i32 {
    // SAFETY: negative control, the program's own declaration.
    unsafe { own::getpid() }
}
pub fn fake_pid() -> i32 {
    // SAFETY: negative control, `#[link_name = "getppid"] fn getpid` in a crate named libc.
    unsafe { fakelibc::getpid() }
}
pub fn fake_sid(p: i32) -> i32 {
    // SAFETY: negative control, `#[link_name = "getsid"] fn session_of`.
    unsafe { fakelibc::session_of(p) }
}
